verdict.line: You lose lane if you eat Mordekaiser's W (Siphon of Destruction) at full range and keep his passive shield topped off; you win if you freeze under tower until his shield decays, then commit full trades and finish with R once he's already chunked.

brief.thesis: Mordekaiser out-ranges you with W (Siphon of Destruction) and sustains every trade through his passive (Indestructible) shield, which is why OP.GG grades this lane 49.3% over 665 games with lane and solo-kill advantage to him. You have no gap closer besides Flash, so the entire lane is about denying him free pokes and picking the exact windows — W on cooldown, shield decayed — where your E (Judgment)-based trade actually lands instead of getting absorbed.

theirWindow.when: his shield is freshly refreshed by W or an auto
theirWindow.what: Disengage and reset to minions. Trading into a full Indestructible shield means your Q auto and E spin tick into mitigation instead of health — you're just feeding it. Let it decay (a few seconds without him dealing damage) before you commit again.

yourWindow.what: This is your all-in window. Walk up, Q (Decisive Strike) to silence and speed up, land the empowered auto, then E (Judgment) spin through the full duration — without W he has no ranged deterrent to punish your approach and his shield has nothing to feed on.

start.why: The higher-winrate start (50.3% over 451 games) — the flat damage block and HP5 blunt his early auto-poke and give you the sustain to hold the wave near your tower instead of getting bullied off it.

boots.why: Highest pick rate (66.8%) and the attack speed shortens the window your E and empowered Q auto need to actually punish him when his W is down.

core.why: The Rush active is your only real way to close distance on a champion whose entire lane plan is poking you from W range — this is the single biggest reason the matchup improves once you hit level 9-10.
Attack speed and move speed keep you stuck to him through his kite pattern instead of letting him walk you down with autos between W cooldowns.

Grievous Wounds cuts directly into his Indestructible shield strength — this is the item that actually flips extended duels in your favor, matching the 53.3% winrate on this exact path over 169 games.

situational.when: he's stacking Indestructible hard and you need burst shield-shred on top of Mortal Reminder for a clean all-in
you're already ahead and want a second gap-close/burst window to punish him before his shield resets
his poke and ability damage are outpacing your sustain item and you need to survive the W chip damage to reach your spike

runes.keystoneWhy: This page runs 55.2% over the alternative's 47.6% in this matchup, and the logic tracks: Stormraider's rewards the constant repositioning you need to dodge his W cone, and it procs off just walking into range rather than needing a landed ability like Conqueror does against a poke-heavy opponent you can't always reach.

summoners.why: Flash+Ignite is run in 91.4% of games at 49.7% WR — Ignite's Grievous Wounds stacks with your Mortal Reminder timing to strip his shield sustain during your all-in window, and it turns your R execute threshold much lower than his passive can offset.

playing.title: Trade only when his shield is down
playing.detail: If he hasn't auto-attacked or landed W in the last several seconds, his Indestructible shield is decayed — that's the only time your Q-auto-E trade deals real damage instead of feeding mitigation.

playing.title: Juke his W, don't facetank it
playing.detail: Siphon of Destruction is a wide frontal cone but it's still dodgeable — step behind minions or sidestep in melee range rather than eating it point-blank, since every landed W both pokes you and refills his shield.

playing.title: Never all-in with E down
playing.detail: Your skill order maxes E (Judgment) first, so it's your primary trade damage — don't walk up or Flash in for a fight unless E is up, or you're trading auto-for-auto into a champion with a passive shield.

playing.title: Hold Flash for his E, not offense
playing.detail: Death's Grasp roots you in place to set up his all-in, and his R (Realm of Death) locks you into an isolated 1v1 — save Flash to get out of E range rather than using it to initiate.

playing.title: Time R for a decayed shield
playing.detail: Demacian Justice's true damage still gets absorbed by an active Indestructible shield, so only cash in your execute once his shield has decayed or after Ignite/Mortal Reminder have already cut it down.

playing.title: Freeze before level 6
playing.detail: Since short trades lose to his sustain and his W punishes you for approaching, freezing the wave near your tower through levels 3-5 denies his poke angle entirely and forces him to overextend for CS.

brief.patchCaveat: Build paths, rune pages, summoners, and win rates here are pulled directly from measured OP.GG games on the current patch (665 games, 49.3% WR for this matchup); the trade timing, shield-decay logic, and cooldown-window calls are my own read on top of that data.

stats.opponentTip: Do not let Mordekaiser maintain his (P) by hitting and running often. Try to kill him when (W) is on cooldown.
